definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is genuine, trustworthy, and acts with integrity in their dealings with others. A highly valued personal quality in Japanese society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誠実|せいじつ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{誠実|せいじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれて→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}しています→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
examples.english: I appreciate you handling this sincerely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誠実|せいじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His attitude of approaching work with sincerity was appreciated.

notes:
USAGE:
{誠実|せいじつ} is a な-adjective used to describe people or attitudes. It modifies nouns with な ({誠実|せいじつ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧) and can also be used adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({誠実|せいじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧). It carries a strong positive connotation and is commonly used in both personal and professional contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誠実|せいじつ}な⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧: sincere personality
- {誠実|せいじつ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: sincere response/handling
- {誠実|せいじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}き{合|あ}う→向き合う：04652_mukiau⟧: to face sincerely
- {誠実|せいじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work honestly
- {誠実|せいじつ}さ: sincerity (noun form with さ)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧ (serious, earnest) focuses on diligence and conscientiousness, while {誠実|せいじつ} emphasizes honesty and trustworthiness in relationships. ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧ (honest) is about truthfulness in speech, while {誠実|せいじつ} is broader, covering one's entire conduct.
